description: This file defines the UriNormalizer class in the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace, providing methods focused on normalizing and comparing URIs according to specific standards and project requirements. It includes constants for various normalization strategies and static methods for normalization, comparison, and internal processing of URI components.

classes.name: UriNormalizer
classes.description: A final class providing static methods and constants for normalizing and comparing URIs, following RFC 3986 with project-specific normalizations.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns a normalized URI based on specified normalization flags, applying actions such as case correction, percent-encoding normalization, removing default ports/hosts, and sorting query parameters.

methods.name: isEquivalent
methods.description: Determines whether two URIs are equivalent after normalization, considering optional normalization strategies.
